segments.text:
V. 12.
Greater works than theſe ſhall he do—So one Apoſtle wrought Miracles merely by his Shadow (Acts v. 15.) another by Handkerchiefs carried from his Body (Acts xix. 12.) and all ſpake with various Tongues. But the converting one Sinner is a greater Work than all theſe. Becauſe I go to my Father—To fend you the Holy Ghoſt.
